fd7bfead716f: If the app closed unexpectedly or the window went blank · translationCore 4 Help
55b76d8a66e8: tC4 records each step that changes a project. If it stops in the middle of one, it finishes or cleans up at the next start, so no broken project is left.
78bd5ab8337d: If the window goes blank or stops responding
87388e67fa24: Open the Window menu and click Reload, or press Ctrl+R.
b5fd05422653: tC4 comes back on Home. Open your project again.
699657357b3c: If you see "This screen could not be shown.", click Back to Home, then open the project again.
8b0d89d59a34: Check that your projects are on Home.
e0c604da4f04: If an import was interrupted, import the file again.
f38932ff0291: Reload takes you to Home. Your projects are still there.
814d83120c04: Toggle Developer Tools is for developers. You don't need it.
b55e6bd5d484: The Window menu of the desktop app, with Reload Ctrl+R, Force Reload Ctrl+Shift+R and Toggle Developer Tools Ctrl+Shift+I.
